scientific_integrity.computational_checks: Two standalone pure-Python programs reproduce the finite-field and quartic checks. They do not prove the theorem for arbitrary prime powers.
scientific_integrity.limitations: The universal rational Gauss-incidence profile holds only for q>=5 and only for Sziklai-optimal curves; the complete odd-theta Frobenius profile is proved only for the optimal quartic at q=5. Classical bitangent formulas and unindexed priority precedents remain a risk.
scientific_integrity.main_prior_theorems: The classification of all Sziklai-optimal degree-(q-1) curves and the unique class at q=5 are established previously and are used as premises, not claimed original.

title: Three missing tangent points of Sziklai-optimal curves and the quartic Frobenius-bitangent spectrum
